### Motivation
- Record the owner's September 17 review decision and 12:29Z ruling: a fresh Opus session counts as independent even when another Opus session modified the PR.

### Description
- Permit fresh Opus reviewer sessions to review any PR they have never worked on, including Opus-modified PRs. Cross-model review remains preferred when it costs nothing; family provenance alone does not exclude a reviewer.
- Record the interim family exclusion as superseded in `local/protocols/EVOLUTION.md`. Retain the three-fixer/three-reviewer Mac allocation, trusted instructions, exact-head read-only COMMENT evidence, MAIN's fail-closed status publication, section 13 carry, and existing caps and merge rules.

### Testing
- Hook installation, whitespace checks, ordinary commit hooks and checked publication passed.
- Canonical CI passed on `a9e6c2644ffc3a04e04a4c0fd733b9ee31c0e1f5`: all nine CI statuses are successful, including the full Lean build and blueprint checks. The workflow suite ran 637 tests with nine skips.
- The rooted blueprint axiom audit reports PASS 1610, FAIL 0 and four statement-only warnings. This amendment changes only two documentation files; independent review remains pending.
